name: com.unity.2d.animation
description: 2D Animation provides all the necessary tooling and runtime components for skeletal animation using Sprites.

samples.description: Various 2D Animation sample scenes to show different usage of the 2D Animation tooling for various outcomes.

_upm.changelog:
### Changed
- Replace the native Bounded Biharmonic Weights module with a Burst-compiled solver. Generated weights are unchanged within floating-point noise, and weight generation now behaves identically on every Editor platform. A bone shorter than 0.01 pixels that is chained to another bone now weights the mesh around the joint, where the native module left it without any weight. (D2D-8319)
- IK Manager 2D now resolves the visibility of the Sprite Skins driven by its solvers on demand, instead of through a hidden scene manager that polled every Sprite Skin in the scene each frame. The behaviour of Always Update is unchanged. (D2D-8395)
- Removed the com.unity.collections dependency, as Collections is an engine module in Unity 7000.0.
- Remove SRP-Batcher hard requirement for GPU-Skinning.
- Pin hosted package documentation links to com.unity.2d.animation@18.0 and align Unity Manual and Script Reference links to Unity 7000.0.
- Improved SpriteSkin deformation performance by no longer null-checking every SpriteSkin Transform each frame.
- `FABRIK2D.Solve` now returns false without iterating when the chain has fewer than two positions (FABRIK Solver 2D with a Chain Length of 1). Previously it ran up to the solver iteration limit every frame and returned true although no position changed.
- SpriteSkin with Auto Rebind enabled now rebinds when the Sprite's bones are changed with Sprite.SetBones, and no longer rebinds when the Sprite is bound to a Sprite Atlas or its mesh data is changed. (D2D-8433)
- Improve SpriteSkin's per-frame performance by no longer reading each Sprite's texture every frame to detect Sprite Atlas binding.

### Fixed
- Fix the Sprite Library Editor labels list not scrolling with the mouse wheel when the cursor is over the empty space between labels. (UUM-155099)
- Fix empty space appearing in the Sprite Library Editor labels grid view, below the last label or at the top of the view, after resizing the items with the size slider, adding a label, or dragging the scroll bar to the bottom, until the view was scrolled up and back. (UUM-155113)
- Fix the Sprite Library Editor renaming the selected label when double-clicking the scroll bar of the labels grid view. (UUM-151668)
- Fix the Categories title bar overlapping the category list, which could make the add category button unclickable, when the Sprite Library Editor window is resized to a short height. (UUM-151676)
- Fix the Skinning Editor writing a window-size dependent sub-pixel remainder from the Sprite Editor canvas' origin, scroll and zoom into authored bone and mesh coordinates, by snapping mouse input to a texture-pixel grid no coarser than one screen pixel. Coordinates are whole texture pixels at or below 100% zoom, and halves, quarters ... when zoomed in. (UUM-151700)
- Fix SpriteSkin dereferencing freed Sprite buffers after the Sprite was changed in place, such as reimporting it with an instance in a loaded scene, which could crash the Editor. (UUM-150275)
- Fix renaming a Category or Label ignoring keyboard input when the Sprite Library Editor window is not focused. (UUM-151677)
- Fix the Sprite Library Editor discarding the label name typed so far, and the rename field losing keyboard focus, when the labels view is rebuilt during a rename, such as when resizing the window in Grid view or changing the view size. Switching between List and Grid view now commits the typed name instead of discarding it. (UUM-155100)
- Fix ArgumentOutOfRangeExceptions thrown when selecting vertices with the Skinning Editor's Weight Slider on a Sprite that has never had weights assigned, and disable the Weight Inspector when no bones influence the mesh. (UUM-152583)
- Fix removing an IK solver in the IK Manager 2D Inspector destroying the whole GameObject the solver is on, which took any other component on it with it, including the IK Manager 2D itself, and logging Console errors when the solver was removed on a Prefab asset. The GameObject is now only destroyed when it holds nothing but the solver, the solver is destroyed once the Inspector has finished drawing,
